_note: Human-reviewed moments from three VAST workshop archive clips (San Francisco, sf_streets_cam-4), pulled from the team's authorized VSS Explore session on 2026-10-02. Clips are the first 5-second segments. Clothing descriptions were written by looking at the extracted frames; they are NOT Cosmos output and no detector was run, so bounding_box is null and provenance.detection is null. No identity, demographic, or brand information is recorded. Where present, bounding_box and track come from an OFFLINE run of YOLOv8n + ByteTrack on this machine (person class only), with the track for each reviewed person chosen by a human from numbered candidates. Tracks are within a single clip only; nothing links people across clips.
